newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA SHIPYARD ON OFFICIAL LIST EARLY MAY.
newsitem.headline: RIGA SHIPYARD ON OFFICIAL LIST EARLY MAY.

text.p: Riga stock exchange said on Thursday that Riga Shipyard has submitted an application to be quoted on the bourse's official list.

"The company today handed in an application asking to be admitted to the official list following its shareholders' meeting on April 27," Guntar Kokarevich, finance department director of Riga bourse, told Reuters.
"The stock exchange board will decide on the issue tomorrow and I would say that the company will be on the bourse in the very first days of May," he added.

Kokarevich said that after receiving the company's 1996 audited annual report and signing an agreement with the company, it usually takes three to four days before actual trading in its shares begins.
The company earlier said that its 1996 profit was 235,000 lats on turnover of 12 million lats, an increase of seven million lats from 1995.
The shares in the firm were auctioned this week for 1.39 lats.
